definitions.explanation: Practical training exercises conducted by military forces to prepare for real operations. Includes field exercises, war games, and joint maneuvers.
An academic course or session focused on practical application and discussion rather than lectures. Common in university settings, similar to a seminar or lab session.

notes:
USAGE:
The two senses operate in very different domains. In news contexts, {演習|えんしゅう} almost always refers to military exercises. In academic contexts, it refers to a practical seminar-style class (as opposed to ⟦{講義|こうぎ}→講義：01579_kougi⟧, a lecture).

Also used for emergency drills (disaster preparedness, firefighting) when conducted on a large, organized scale.

Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{円周|えんしゅう}→円周：05442_enshuu⟧ (circumference).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{軍事|ぐんじ}→軍事：14392_gunji⟧{演習|えんしゅう}: military exercise
- ⟦{合同|ごうどう}→合同：04185_goudou⟧{演習|えんしゅう}: joint exercise
- ⟦{防災|ぼうさい}→防災：07907_bousai⟧{演習|えんしゅう}: disaster drill
- {演習|えんしゅう}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧: practice problem
- {演習|えんしゅう}{林|りん}: training forest (university forestry)
